info.title: Investment Lab Strategy Engine
info.description: Strategy decisions, risk checks (also as background jobs), market quotes and symbol lookup for the Investment Lab backend.

schema.title: Response List Strategy Types V1 Strategies Get

ColumnFormat.title: ColumnFormat
ColumnFormat.description: How the report shows a value of a rationale column.

priceSetId.title: Pricesetid
priceSetId.description: A price set uploaded for a replay, sent instead of marketSeries.

historyFrom.title: Historyfrom
historyFrom.description: First day of the price set the call may look at; asOf is the last.

signals.title: Signals
signals.description: States of the user's market signals the parameters refer to.

EvaluationContext.title: EvaluationContext
EvaluationContext.description: Everything a strategy may look at. Data after ``asOf`` is ignored.

InstrumentScore.title: InstrumentScore
InstrumentScore.description:
One row of the "why" table. Only the identity, the decision and its reason are common to every strategy;
the strategy's own metrics go into ``values`` under the ids of ``Rationale.columns``.

JobError.title: JobError
JobError.description: Why a job failed, as the synchronous endpoint would have answered: 422 — the context was refused, 500 — the strategy broke.

path.title: Path
path.description: JSON path of the problem inside the parameters.

historyBars.title: Historybars
historyBars.description: Daily observations required before replay/evaluation, including crossing windows.

signalIds.title: Signalids
signalIds.description: User signals the parameters refer to, when their shape is valid.

PriceSeries.title: PriceSeries
PriceSeries.description: Daily closes of one series, columnar. ``adjustedClose`` drives the signals.

PriceSetUpload.title: PriceSetUpload
PriceSetUpload.description: The prices of one replay, uploaded once and named by later calls.

RationaleColumn.title: RationaleColumn
RationaleColumn.description:
One column of the "why" table; the report draws whatever columns the strategy lists, in this order.

The id names the value in ``InstrumentScore.values``; it must not be ``key`` (the backend renames that one).

schedule.description: When it comes unless the user sets their own time for the account.

signalKinds.title: Signalkinds
signalKinds.description: Built-in signals that also bring this report, unless the user removes the link.

ReportDefinition.title: ReportDefinition
ReportDefinition.description: A report a strategy type makes: the service lists, schedules and generates it from this alone.

ReportMode.title: ReportMode
ReportMode.description: What a report does; the service knows how to make each.

day.title: Day
day.description: Monthly: day of the month; quarterly: of the quarter's first month. A shorter month: its last day.

time.title: Time
time.description: Daily, weekly, monthly, quarterly: local time (HH:mm).

minute.title: Minute
minute.description: Hourly: the minute of every hour.

ReportSchedule.title: ReportSchedule
ReportSchedule.description: When a report comes, in the service's time zone; each frequency reads only its own fields.

SignalKind.title: SignalKind
SignalKind.description: A kind of the service's built-in signals; a report may ask to come when one of them fires.

activeFor.title: Activefor
activeFor.description: Keys of the instruments (as in marketSeries) the signal fires for now.

StrategyDecision.title: StrategyDecision
StrategyDecision.description: Targets, not orders: the backend's rebalancer turns them into trades.

StrategyJob.title: StrategyJob
StrategyJob.description:
A decision or risk assessment that runs in the background (a strategy may think for minutes or hours).

``result`` is what ``/decide`` or ``/risk`` returns, once the job has succeeded.

defaultParameters.title: Defaultparameters
defaultParameters.description: Null for a type whose parameters are always written in full, such as rules.

supportsBacktest.title: Supportsbacktest
supportsBacktest.description: False for a strategy that cannot answer thousands of times in a row, such as an AI agent.

backtestComparisons.title: Backtestcomparisons
backtestComparisons.description: What a backtest of this type is shown next to, in this order: only the comparisons that answer a question about it.

messages.title: Messages
messages.description: The texts of this type's message codes by language code (uk, en).

SymbolLookupResponse.title: SymbolLookupResponse
SymbolLookupResponse.description: One entry per query, in order; ``null`` when no candidate exists.

SymbolQuery.title: SymbolQuery
SymbolQuery.description: Yahoo symbols to try in order; the first one that exists (in ``currency``, when given) wins.
